name: folio
description: Magazine-style presentation skill that turns structured content into editable decks across HTML, PPTX, PDF, Figma, and IDML.
release_highlights: Reworked all 19 reference wireframes with responsive bleed, trim, safe, and content guides, and fixed overlapping or undersized placeholder labels.
Added a required 1600px, 1000px, and 700px browser QA pass covering pseudo-elements, nested cells, image-text overlap, and clipping.
Added a magazine investigative feature family with thesis-opener, dense-reading, and image-evidence spread variants.
Added Lorem Ipsum body-flow placeholders and explicit center-gutter, safe-frame, and live-copy guidance.
Retained the editorial-longform portrait family and its content-boundary correction.
